meta.title: Research Hub — Book a Seat by the Hour | Robonauts
meta.description: Book a seat at the Robonauts Research Hub in Uttara, Dhaka. Work on your robotics and electronics projects with our kits, components and tools. Pay per person per hour with bKash.

hero.title: A space to build, test and research
hero.subtitle: Come alone or bring your team. Sit for as long as you need and use our robotics kits, electronic components and tools. Book your hours online and pay with bKash.
hero.groupNote: A group of 3 for 2 hours is ৳{example}.

board.note: Live from bookings. Pick a time to book it.

inventory.title: What's in the hub
inventory.subtitle: Everything here is included in your booking. Tell us what you plan to use and we'll have it ready.

seating.title: Seating and workbenches
seating.text: Comfortable desks for long sessions, discussions and group work.

kits.title: Robotics kits
kits.text: Arduino, ESP32, sensor kits, motors, drivers and chassis kits.

components.title: Electronic components
components.text: Resistors, LEDs, ICs, breadboards, jumper wires, batteries and more.

tools.title: Tools and equipment
tools.text: Soldering stations, multimeters, power supplies and hand tools.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi and power
wifi.text: Fast internet and charging points at every seat.

help.title: Friendly staff
help.text: Our team is around to help you find parts and use equipment safely.

rules.title: House rules
rules.r1: Arrive on time. Your slot ends at the booked time.
rules.r2: Kits and components are for use inside the hub only. Return them before you leave.
rules.r3: Handle tools safely. Ask staff before using soldering or power equipment.
rules.r4: Participants under 18 need permission from a parent or guardian.
rules.r5: Keep the space clean and respect other researchers.
